interpretation.primaryBlocker: V7 native ranked-event decoder, not the learned V7 state representation.
interpretation.evidence: Applying frozen V4 hysteresis to unchanged V7 state probabilities improves macro F1 from 0.1616 to 0.2462 and slightly exceeds the V4 model benchmark without any retraining.
interpretation.eventHead: Ranking signal is useful but insufficiently precise as the sole event-start admission mechanism; true-event rank-1 rate is ~68.9% / 59.3%.

decision.nextDirection: V8 should preserve frozen V7 representation/training objective and replace native ranked-event admission with a fixed hybrid decoder based on V4 hysteresis/state continuity, optionally using event rank only as secondary tie-break/support. No retraining until decoder-only synthetic and zero-optimizer development evaluation are complete.
